QuestInfo.name: The Blue Haired Man
QuestInfo.0: #p2450002#, #b#p2450001##k, #p2450033#, and #p2450004# were planning to get #p2450003# back, and this would give the duo a chance to get close to the Goddess Teardrop.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2450001# laid out the rescue plan for them.

Step 1. Infiltrate the power plant through the underpass. 
Step 2. Destroy the #r#o9300770##k guards.
Step 3. Rescue #p2450003# while the lights were out.

#p2450004# would remain behind to cover the rear. #p2450002# would rescue #p2450003# while Alpha and Beta dealt with the #o9300770# guards. Afterwards, they could talk to the kidnapper...
QuestInfo.2: This Goddess Teardrop was nothing like the others... #p2450000#, the blue-haired man, was trying to break his connection with the Transcendents! He kidnapped the girl, and he was using the power plant to fuel his plans

0.0: Like Wonny told you, the plan's set. Let me run you through it.
0.1: One! We have to get into the power station. That's why we're here. There's an #bunderpass#k that runs right into the mines below the floor where they used to run Rue Ore back and forth. Sure, there'll be killer robots along the way, but no biggie, right?
0.2: Two! We have to take out three power generators. This is where we were a little short-handed before... If we're all blowing up generators, who goes to get Gabrielle? That's where you two come in. Go #rdestroy a power generator#k, and Wonny can swoop in for Gabrielle.
0.3: Three! The lights will go out when the power goes down. That's Wonny's cue to rescue Gabrielle. We return to town, you go #btalk to the kidnapper#k. Don't care. Simple enough, yeah?
0.4: What're you standing around waiting for? Chop chop! Take the #bwestern portal#k to access the underpass when you're ready.

1.0: Hahaha! I have no intention of following YOU. Why should I?
